title: Almost-minimality under a retracted cycle modification (Simon 7.2.4 (8)–(9) with Remark 7.2.5(2); step 7 (I) of the parent)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, A ⊆ ℝ^P, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in A (contract IsMinimizingIn T A) with spt T ⊆ A. Let G, G₃, L ∈ ℝ with 0 < G ≤ G₃, closedBall(0, G₃) ⊆ U and M_{B_{G₃}(0)}(T) < ∞. Let π : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C¹ on B_{2G}(0) (ContDiffOn ℝ 1), with π(B_{2G}(0)) ⊆ A ∩ B_{G₃}(0), π(y) = y for every y ∈ A ∩ B_{2G}(0), and ‖Dπ(y)‖ ≤ L (operator norm of fderiv) for every y ∈ B_{2G}(0). Let Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity with ∂Y = 0 and spt Y compact and contained in B_G(0), and let Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy Z(ω) = T(ω) + Y(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (Y evaluated on the same form regarded as a test form on ℝ^P, testFormOnInclusion). Assume the push-forward theorem (PF) for (P, m): for every open O ⊆ ℝ^P, every f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P that is C¹ on O and every c ∈ ℝ with ‖Df(y)‖ ≤ c for y ∈ O, there is a map push : 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) → 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that (A) for every X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with spt X compact and contained in O and every IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of X in ℝ^P: (i) push X(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(f(x)) ∘ Λⁿ Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), (ii) push X is integer multiplicity, (iii) spt(push X) ⊆ f(spt X), (iv) M(push X) ≤ cⁿ·M(X) (ENNReal.ofReal(cⁿ)), (v) ∂X = 0 implies ∂(push X) = 0, (vi) if f(y) = y for every y ∈ spt X then push X = X; and (B) push(X₁ − X₂) = push X₁ − push X₂ for all integer multiplicity X₁, X₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with compact supports contained in O. Then M_{B_G(0)}(T) ≤ Lⁿ·M_{B_G(0)}(Z) in [0, ∞] (Lⁿ read as ENNReal.ofReal(Lⁿ)).
